name: release-notes-suite
description: Two-stage release pipeline for Acme CRM / Acme Notify (Acme). harvester builds the complete engineering release inventory (every shipped story/defect across both boards plus non-ticketed PR/commit deployments); releaser turns an inventory or technical draft into client-facing release notes in the support-team house style, with Acme Notify and Acme CRM brand variants.
